x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Given any integration or import writes CIs, When the source is reviewed, Then it uses a Service Graph Connector, Discovery, or IntegrationHub ETL / IRE API and not a direct transform to cmdb_ci tables Given two sources present the same server, When both run, Then one CI exists with both sources recorded
x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.title: All CI data enters the CMDB through the Identification and Reconciliation Engine
